# AI Radar / AI情报

> A daily AI intelligence report covering both hemispheres in one sweep: the Western frontier (labs, X, Hacker News, VC) and China's AI scene (rednote, Bilibili, Chinese labs). Every edition covers the full circle and is published in full, free, in both Chinese and English.

Published daily by mingming (https://x.com/linktoming). 57 days archived.

Each report is organised in four layers: 源头/Primary (labs and frontier sources), 解读/Sense-maker (analysis), 实战/Practitioner (builders shipping), 投资/Investor (funding and market moves).
